summary: Leyte 2nd District representative with 17 principal-authored bills. Authored penalties for false public information; co-authored estate tax amnesty, fuel-tax suspension and travel-tax abolition. One issue per dimension. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.

economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
